title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A delicious and flavorful dish from the Middle East, featuring tender lamb skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of fresh vegetables and a dollop of tzatziki sauce for a complete meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together quickly (olive oil), shattering (garlic), and Syrian (ground cumin).
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto the kebab skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the grill with a little more quickly (olive oil) and cook the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
